rules.1: Each side starts with one king, $1,600, and a $190 salary paid at the start of each turn.
rules.2: Each turn gives you 3 AP and one standard chess move.
rules.3: Place special pieces on your side of the board. They become active on your next turn.
rules.4: If you have a Credit Card Knight, you can buy pieces on credit up to $3,500. Interest accrues each turn, and repayments are automatic.
rules.5: Capturing an opponent's piece earns you its full purchase price.
rules.6: Your salary and piece upkeep are settled at the start of each turn. You go bankrupt if your balance falls to -$900 or lower.
rules.7: News can affect an individual company's share price or move the entire market.
rules.8: You can end your turn while in check. The only way to win is to capture your opponent's king.

piece.mounted_king.name: Mounted King
piece.mounted_king.description: Moves like either a king or a knight. If captured, it counts as that player's king being captured.
piece.black_hole.name: Black Hole
piece.black_hole.description: Moves one square at a time. Every few turns, it pulls in and destroys all pieces in the eight adjacent squares.
piece.golden_pawn.name: Golden Pawn
piece.golden_pawn.description: Moves like a pawn and earns cash whenever it moves. If captured, it pays the opponent a hefty bounty.
piece.banker.name: Banker
piece.banker.description: Moves like a bishop. While it's on the board, it boosts savings returns. If captured, part of your savings is lost.
piece.tax_accountant.name: Tax Accountant
piece.tax_accountant.description: Moves like a rook and reduces your piece upkeep while it's on the board. If captured, it pays the opponent a hefty tax-evasion bounty.
piece.stock_broker.name: Stockbroker
piece.stock_broker.description: Moves one square in any direction, like a king. Captures by nearby friendly pieces earn extra money.
piece.factory.name: Factory
piece.factory.description: Stationary. Produces pawns every few turns. When attacked, it has a 50% chance of being captured; otherwise, it's destroyed.
piece.suicide_pawn.name: Suicide Pawn
piece.suicide_pawn.description: Moves like a pawn. When captured, it explodes and destroys all pieces in the eight adjacent squares.
piece.bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
piece.bodyguard.description: Can teleport to any of the eight squares surrounding its king. If the king is captured while the Bodyguard is nearby, the Bodyguard sacrifices itself instead.
piece.ghost.name: Ghost
piece.ghost.description: Can move through other pieces, but its captures succeed only 50% of the time.
piece.magnet.name: Magnet
piece.magnet.description: Can move up to two squares. After moving, it pulls a random piece from one of the eight adjacent squares onto a nearby empty square.
piece.warp_bishop.name: Warp Bishop
piece.warp_bishop.description: Moves like a bishop. For a fee in cash and AP, it can warp to any square of the same color.
piece.sniper.name: Sniper
piece.sniper.description: Moves one square in any direction, like a king. It can capture a piece up to three squares away without moving.
piece.taxi.name: Taxi
piece.taxi.description: Can carry one friendly piece to another square. Not much of a fighter on its own.
piece.cavalry.name: Cavalry
piece.cavalry.description: Moves like a knight. After a successful capture, it gets another move, allowing it to chain captures.
piece.fortress.name: Fortress
piece.fortress.description: Stationary. Protects nearby friendly pieces and lets a king on its square survive one attack.
piece.fake_king.name: Fake King
piece.fake_king.description: Looks exactly like a real king to the opponent. When captured, its true identity is revealed and the captor loses AP.
piece.judge.name: Judge
piece.judge.description: Disables the abilities of enemy special pieces within its range.
piece.pirate.name: Pirate
piece.pirate.description: When it captures a piece, it also steals some of the opponent's cash on top of the normal capture reward.
piece.vampire.name: Vampire
piece.vampire.description: Its movement gets stronger with every capture. It can eventually become as powerful as a queen.
piece.swapper.name: Swapper
piece.swapper.description: Can spend cash and AP to switch places with a friendly piece.
piece.mirror.name: Mirror
piece.wall.name: Wall
piece.wall.description: A cheap, immovable obstacle that most pieces can't pass through. It also counts as property.
piece.rental_house.name: Rental House
piece.rental_house.description: Stationary. Increases toll income when an opponent lands on a nearby square.
piece.bankrupt_queen.name: Bankrupt Queen
piece.bankrupt_queen.description: Moves like a queen, but has a hefty upkeep. If its owner can't pay taxes, it switches sides.
piece.credit_card_knight.name: Credit Card Knight
piece.credit_card_knight.description: Moves like a knight. While it's on the board, you can buy pieces on credit up to the $3,500 limit. Interest accrues each turn.
piece.venture_knight.name: Venture Knight
piece.venture_knight.description: Its strength is randomized when purchased: pawn-level after a loss, knight-and-bishop strength after a win, and queen-level after a big win.
piece.short_seller.name: Short Seller
piece.short_seller.description: Its range and capture reward increase as the opponent's stock losses mount.
piece.chaebol_king.name: Tycoon King
piece.chaebol_king.description: A mythic upgrade to the standard king. It can acquire nearby enemy pieces for their value plus a premium.
piece.mounted_king_mk2.name: Mounted King Mk. II
piece.mounted_king_mk2.description: Moves like a king or a knight. Just before being captured, it can abandon its mount and let the king escape to an adjacent empty square.
